rationale: The Court is likely to read Petrella as committing the Court to a three-year backward limit on monetary relief even when a claim is timely under discovery accrual, preserving § 507(b)'s repose function without deciding the broader accrual question. Separate writings are most likely from Justice Thomas (to press that accrual is at infringement under TRW/Rotkiske) and from the dissenters (to argue the statute sets only a commencement rule and contains no remedial cap).
